Container.Name: UltraExplorer
Container.Overview:
Ultra Explorer is a file explorer for your cloud storage and NAS folders, built on rclone. Browse, copy, move and synchronize files between about 40 storage providers and the shares of this server from a web interface.
Before the first start, create the appdata folder with owner nobody:users (99:100). Set an administrator password of at least 12 characters. Files in /mnt/local are read and written as nobody:users.

Config.Name: Administrator password
Config.Description: Password to sign in, at least 12 characters.

Config.Name: Local files
Config.Description: Folder of this server shown as local files. Use a narrower share, or read-only access, to limit what the app can change.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Database, rclone configuration and credentials. Must be writable by nobody:users (99:100).

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Set to true only when the app is reached through an HTTPS reverse proxy.
